title: New York City - Midtown Manhattan
description: Midtown Manhattan generated from NYC Open Data: every building at its real roof height, every street at its real width, parks and rivers in place, with window decals, Times Square screens, traffic, pedestrians and construction sites to fly. About 95,000 objects, so turn shadows and foliage down on slower machines. Generated with the open-source tools at github.com/noodlemctwoodle/Uncrashed-Maps.
